- Added copyright statement to SKILL.md.
- Removed the outdated skill-card.md file.
- No changes made to logic, workflow, or feature set.

TRIZ Innovation Analysis Assistant initial release.

- Supports structured TRIZ innovation solution analysis through a step-by-step workflow.
- Core features include system component analysis, contact relationship analysis, functional modeling, causal chain/root cause analysis, and innovation solution generation.
- Follows strict data integrity rules between steps to prevent information loss.
- Output adapts to summary or detail display mode based on configuration.
- Auto-selects and highlights core technical problems for in-depth causal chain analysis.
- Guides users through solution selection and provides comprehensive solution details.
